pages.title: Chiral Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that comes in only one hand. Like my left and right palms, its mirror image cannot be rotated to match it. Living things use left-handed amino acids and right-handed sugars, and nobody fully knows why. This one twists light passing through it, always the same way.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Molecular orbitals let me predict which hand a molecule would take. Seeding an orbital lattice with amethyst and a quantum dot in supercritical solvent, I found the crystals all came out with the same handedness. I stopped calling it an accident after the tenth batch.
